dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, continuous geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth, convex lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical indentations or protrusions visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity consistent with slate grey, transitioning to lighter tones in the posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-grey mottling localized primarily on the anterior lateral margins and upper dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients with low edge contrast between the primary grey baseline and mottled clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast curvilinear dark mark (scratch or rake) is visible on the mid-posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle longitudinal shadow-casting along the posterior midline consistent with a structural dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a thin, dark curvilinear epidermal mark on the mid-posterior dorsal surface; blowhole visible as a high-contrast dark aperture near the anterior apex.
